# Cyber 72 teaching notes

The ten mission topics and Bengali story concepts were supplied for this project. The English/Bangla adaptations preserve those scenarios, with explanations that describe risks rather than claiming every click automatically hacks a device or that one precaution guarantees safety. Health loss is an in-game teaching mechanic, not a claim about the player's real device.

## Reference checks

- [bKash security tips](https://www.bkash.com/en/page/security-tips): keep PINs and verification codes private, and verify transaction requests independently. Used for the PIN/OTP and impersonation lessons.
- [Meta Safety Centre: avoid phishing and scams](https://www.meta.com/en-gb/safety/topics/safety-basics/tools/avoid/): verify suspicious messages and avoid unfamiliar links or attachments. Used for message and login-page guidance.
- [FTC: how to spot and avoid task scams](https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2025/08/how-spot-avoid-task-scams): paying to unlock work or supposed earnings is a task-scam warning. Used for the joining-fee lesson.

Checked on 10 November 2026. These references are documentation only; the game does not need them online to run. They do not imply affiliation or endorsement.

## Deliberate refinements

- An unknown prize link can lead to requests for money or information; the game does not claim that merely clicking every link instantly empties an account.
- Cash on delivery and reviews alone do not guarantee a genuine item. The shopping lessons also mention independent checks, inspection rules, buyer protection and safe meetings with a trusted adult.
- Read the full website domain. Neither a padlock nor a particular domain ending proves safety. The phishing example uses the inert, non-linked training address `facebookk-login-bd.invalid` and never sends players to a suspicious website.
- Unknown APKs may contain malware; the lesson directs players to verified publishers and official sources, without claiming that all APK files are malicious.
- Urgent countdowns and implausible prices are reasons to stop and verify, rather than reasons to rush into payment.
